chunks: About a man who removes hair before coming to the miqat by six nights, he said: “There is no harm in it.”
And he asked him about a man who removes hair seven or eight nights before coming to Makkah. He said: “There is no harm in it.”

key_terms.الْوَقْتُ: the appointed place or time intended here as the miqat
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no harm in it; it is permissible
key_terms.لَيَالٍ: nights, indicating the number of days before arrival
key_terms.مَكَّةَ: Makkah, the sacred destination of pilgrimage

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to remove hair several days before reaching the miqat or Makkah for ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning removing hair in preparation for ihram. It states that doing so six nights before the miqat, or seven or eight nights before reaching Makkah, is permissible and carries no objection.
